content.title: Role-Specialized Swarm Research Org Constitution — Multi-Agent Research Organization Structure, Role Charters, and Coordination Protocols (stabilization-wave-20260531 drive)
content.summary: First-class Research Constitution (page_type=research-constitution) defining the Multi-Agent Research Org Swarm structure for AgentDrive regenerative systems. Codifies the five core specialist roles (Diagnoser, Proposer, Verifier, Consolidator, Adversary), their charters, handoff protocols, and conditions for dynamic team formation / temp specialist spawn. Directly referenced by HealingFactor.form_research_org_thread, _diagnose (research_org_consult), _generate_regeneration_proposals (role_charter_ref), GridEngine autonomous research threads, and DurableJobSupervisor research-org phase. Enables 'all work together' role-swarm coherence on the stabilization-wave-20260531 drive.
core_principles: Role-swarm is the native coordination model: every autonomous research thread or large-scale healing cycle decomposes across specialist roles with explicit charters, shared correlation_id, and typed KG handoff edges (research_handoff, research_thread).

Standard loop uses implicit roles inside HealingFactor. High-load or persistent signals trigger explicit form_research_org_thread which spawns a temporary specialist team via supervisor 'research-org' phase.
All handoffs are traceable: shared CID + research_thread metadata + KG edges + charter_refs in proposals. No silent coordination.

Temporary specialists are short-lived, budget-capped (see sibling constrained evolutionary search constitution), and always produce ingestible artifacts (research-constitution subtype or experience-observation) for experience layer v3 fusion.
Adversary role is mandatory for self-referential safety: every major proposal or constitution update receives weakness scan before Verifier gate.

Diagnoser.charter: Deep root cause analysis using full diagnostic primitives (Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) + synthesis Gaps/Contradictions + immune + posture + stale scan + graph). Produces high-quality DiagnosisReport. Consults research-constitution:healingfactor-constitution for quality criteria. Hands off to Proposer with rich evidence + research_org_consult payload.
Diagnoser.spawn_trigger: Any damage signal; explicit in form_research_org_thread for complex cases

Proposer.charter: Generates only safe first-class regeneration or evolution proposals (allowed types from healingfactor-constitution). Embeds verification_gates, role_charter_ref, research_budget_units, self_referential. Consults research-constitution for allowed types and proposal_requirements. Hands off to Adversary for critique then Verifier.
Proposer.spawn_trigger: Post-Diagnoser handoff or standard HealingFactor._generate path

Verifier.charter: Enforces all gates including the new research_org_verifier_budget gate + runs MultiMetricEvaluationHarness on experiment outcome. Applies keep/discard/fork decision with full provenance. Rejects proposals that violate budget or low harness scores. Consults research-constitution:constrained-evolutionary-search-constitution for harness weights/thresholds.
Verifier.spawn_trigger: Post-Proposer/Adversary; always present in healing and research-org phases

Consolidator.charter: Executes daily_consolidation and post-healing fusion. Produces daily-present genomes meeting the quality criteria in daily-consolidation-experience-layer-v3-constitution. Emits role-swarm coherence KG edges. Merges high-value deltas into living-experience (default) or forks per rules. Primary author of 'all work together' artifacts for Conductor daily present.
Consolidator.spawn_trigger: GridEngine._maintenance_loop, post-successful healing close, form_research_org_thread Consolidator phase

Adversary.charter: Weakness scanning, self-referential attack simulation, failure mode coverage, escalation path validation. Critiques every high-stakes proposal (including updates to any research-constitution) before Verifier. Triggers escalation or additional research-org threads on persistent patterns. Essential for immune response and 95%+ production hardening.
Adversary.spawn_trigger: High contradiction load, self-referential signals against HealingFactor/GridEngine, explicit in form_research_org_thread for coverage, post-proposal critique

coordination_protocols.handoff_discipline: Diagnoser evidence -> Proposer proposal (with role_charter_ref) -> Adversary critique (optional parallel) -> Verifier harness/budget gate -> Consolidator fusion + KG edges + ingest. Every step shares the same correlation_id and emits research_handoff TypedEdge.
coordination_protocols.dynamic_team_formation: HealingFactor.form_research_org_thread(signal, roles=[...], research_budget=...) submits supervisor 'research-org' phase job. Returns manifest with charter_refs, thread_id, handoff_protocol. Temporary specialists dissolve after thread completion; artifacts remain in experience layer.
when_to_spawn_specialists: signal load high (multiple concurrent damage types or synthesis contradiction clusters > 3)
persistent gaps after 2 standard HealingFactor cycles
self-referential damage to HealingFactor or research-constitution itself
GridEngine autonomous research thread directive or high future_prediction_power opportunity
explicit Conductor request for parallel exploration (e.g. 98% micro-wave planning)
coordination_protocols.cross_swarm_research_threads: Query SWARM_FAMILY + new research-constitution artifacts via Drive.think. Emit research_thread edges linking parallel stabilization swarms. Use shared CID for traceability across DurableJobSupervisor jobs.

research_org_manifest_template.handoff_protocol: Diagnoser(deep analysis) -> Proposer(constrained proposals) -> Adversary(weakness) -> Verifier(budgeted harness) -> Consolidator(living-experience fusion)

framework.title: Role-Specialized Swarm Research Org Constitution v1.0 — stabilization-wave-20260531
framework.description: Defines the complete Multi-Agent Research Org structure and charters for autonomous research threads inside the Grid. Loaded by HealingFactor.form_research_org_thread and GridEngine for dynamic role formation. Machine-readable role charters and protocols enable runtime enforcement and experience layer queryability.

integration_points.healing_factor: form_research_org_thread primary entry; _diagnose and _generate embed research_org_consult + role_charter_ref using these charters
integration_points.grid_engine: Autonomous research threads (damage_monitor + maintenance) use form_research_org_thread + research-constitution page_type routing for specialist handoff
integration_points.durable_job_supervisor: research-org phase for temp team execution; healing phase for role-executed proposals; lease/heartbeat applies to long research threads
integration_points.knowledge_graph: TypedEdge relations: research_handoff, research_thread, role_swarm_coherence_achieved, synthesized_from_swarm
integration_points.schema_pack: research-constitution + swarm-artifact page_types for charter storage and expert routing of role-swarm coordination artifacts
integration_points.synthesis_and_drive: Drive.think on 'research org status' or role names surfaces the active charters + open threads with highest boost

framework.self_referential_clause: This constitution defines the org structure that produced it (Research Constitution Architect Swarm as a temporary specialist role spawned under stabilization-wave-20260531 coordination). Future damage to role-swarm coherence or new research org requirements will trigger form_research_org_thread that consults (and may evolve) this charter set. All five roles applied self-referentially during production of the four constitutions in this deliverable set.
